biography.bio:
Miles's brother: a reckless racer desperate to prove he's the better Mayhem.

Masks: Deep Freeze (wearing Deep Freeze).

Vehicles: @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.ffhYSqwK5K6EeqFd]{Buzzard}, @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.zHrPhMTAwmrjHrsp]{Buzzard Dragster}.

V.E.N.O.M. - M.A.S.K. homebrew; stats built with the Threat Builder (Field Guide rules).

system.description:
Fires a ray of bitter cold that freezes its target in place.

Maximus Mayhem's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

automation.notes: Rolls against the targets and posts Apply Damage buttons (x degrees of success) and any Condition on a hit. A hit also leaves it Immobilized until the end of its next turn. Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).

system.description:
Jumps, skids and two-wheel turns are just another day at work. Driving Tests have Edge - yours, and those of any vehicle you are driving.

M.A.S.K. homebrew.

automation.notes: Automatic: your Driving Tests, and the Driving Tests of the vehicle you drive, open the Roll Options Dialog with Edge chosen.

system.description:
You never fight fair. Once per scene, as a free action, line up a cheap shot: your next attack this turn is upshifted once.

M.A.S.K. homebrew.

automation.notes: Use button: once per scene, marks you until the end of your turn. Your next attack is upshifted once and uses the mark up.
